pilot_definition.discrepancy: || (Y_sim - y_obs) / sigma ||_2 over all four observations
pilot_definition.seed_streams: data generation, ABC proposals, and simulator noise use separate predeclared seeds

target_distinction.finite_epsilon_target: proportional to P(D <= epsilon | k) with noncentral-chi-square D^2
target_distinction.exact_gaussian_likelihood_target: proportional to exp(-lambda(k)/2), reported as a separate zero-tolerance reference

parameter_diagnostics.diagnostic_note: ESS-scaled errors are descriptive for dependent weighted SMC particles, not confidence guarantees.

semantics.latent: weighted uncertainty in exp(-k*t); no measurement noise
semantics.observation_predictive: latent exp(-k*t) convolved with independent Normal(0, sigma^2) noise

semantics.latent: weighted particles of exp(-k*t); no measurement noise
semantics.observation_predictive: weighted mixture Normal(exp(-k*t), sigma^2); measurement noise included
